_about: Glossary (GlossaryScene, user's pick: a book with chapters, docs/proposals/menu/glossary-book.png). Entries fill in as you meet them (systems/glossary.js, saved in progress.seen at every floor clear and at the end of a run). basics = always open help pages. statuses = one line per status; tab = bad / good / control; statuses not listed are hidden. shortNames = enemy names in the small grid tiles (9 letters fit; longer names show their last word). hiddenEnemies = boss parts and props that are not shown as enemies. layout = screen px.

basics.title: YOUR SQUAD
basics.text: You lead 3 heroes. A hero who falls stays down for the rest of the run. The run ends when all 3 have fallen.

basics.title: FLOORS
basics.text: Each floor is a fight or a special room. A boss waits every 20 floors. Clear a floor to get a reward.

basics.title: AUTO BATTLE
basics.text: Heroes walk, aim and attack on their own. Your job: use their skills at the right time and choose who to hit.

basics.title: SKILLS
basics.text: Every hero has an attack skill (red) and a support skill (green). Tap to use. No mana: a skill is ready again after its cooldown.

basics.title: TAP AND DRAG
basics.text: Tap an enemy: the whole squad focuses it. Drag a hero onto an enemy: only that hero goes after it.

basics.title: DAMAGE TYPES
basics.text: Physical damage is melee or ranged. Magic damage is fire, ice, electric, dark or holy.

basics.title: DEFENSE AND RESIST
basics.text: Defense cuts physical damage, resist cuts magic damage. The more you have, the less you take, but never zero.

basics.title: WEAK AND RESIST
basics.text: Some enemies are weak to a damage type and take extra from it. Others resist one and take less.

basics.title: CRIT AND DODGE
basics.text: A crit hits much harder than a normal hit. Dodge is the chance to take no damage at all from a hit.

basics.title: ITEMS
basics.text: Items work on their own, all the time. Each item goes to one hero. More copies of an item stack up.

basics.title: LEVELS
basics.text: Beaten enemies give XP, shared by the heroes still standing. A level up makes a hero stronger.

basics.title: PERKS AND PASSIVES
basics.text: Each hero gives the whole squad a perk while alive, and has a passive of their own.

bleed.text: Physical damage every second. Defense does not help. Stacks.

doom.text: Dark damage over time, slower attacks, less resist.

armorBreak.text: Less defense: takes more physical damage.

curse.text: Less resist: takes more magic damage.

tangled.text: Caught in sticky webs: much slower attacks.

chill.text: -10% attack speed per stack. 5 stacks = FREEZE.

freeze.text: Frozen solid: cannot attack or cast.

shock.text: Slower attacks, may fumble an attack.

knockback.text: Pushed back: its attack starts over.

taunt.text: Must attack the one who taunted it.

charm.text: Fights for the other side for a while.

parry.text: Ready to counter the next hit.

guaranteedCrit.text: The next hit is a sure crit.

guarded.text: An ally takes hits for it.

reflect.text: Sends damage back to the attacker.
